disclaimer: Influence / coverage style only. Historical canon list, dated. Not an endorsement and not a closed canon.

items.name: Akira Kurosawa
items.notes: Weather as drama; axial multi-cam; wipe time; refuses a hero without a group.

items.name: Yasujirō Ozu
items.notes: Tatami-height stillness; pillow shots; family geometry; refuses dramatic camera opera.

items.name: Kenji Mizoguchi
items.notes: Long-take social space; women against systems; crane as ethics; refuses easy rescue.

items.name: Satyajit Ray
items.notes: Humanist duration; location sound; child-to-adult time; refuses exotic postcard India.

items.name: Ingmar Bergman
items.notes: Face as battlefield; chamber blocking; silence after the question; refuses spectacle cover.

items.name: Andrei Tarkovsky
items.notes: Sculpted duration; elemental image (water, fire); dream logic; refuses plot hurry.

items.name: Sergei Eisenstein
items.notes: Collision montage; graphic match as argument; mass as character; refuses invisible continuity as the only grammar.

items.name: Alfred Hitchcock
items.notes: Point-of-view suspense; object close-ups; audience as accomplice; refuses explaining the bomb.

items.name: Orson Welles
items.notes: Deep-focus rooms; ceiling and angle; long-take bravura; refuses flat coverage.

items.name: John Ford
items.notes: Monument landscape; doorway frames; ritual community; refuses cynicism without a hymn.

items.name: Howard Hawks
items.notes: Overlapping talk; professional groups; competent women; refuses a lone tortured genius as default.

items.name: Billy Wilder
items.notes: Acid structure; voiceover with teeth; moral trap; refuses a scene that does not turn.

items.name: Stanley Kubrick
items.notes: Symmetric dread; steadicam processions; satire in the wide; refuses handheld confession.

items.name: Federico Fellini
items.notes: Circus memory; parade blocking; autobiography as carnival; refuses tight naturalism.

items.name: Agnès Varda
items.notes: Essay-eye; street collect; playful form; refuses a male-only gaze as default.

items.name: Jean-Luc Godard
items.notes: Jump-cut argument; text on image; break the fourth; refuses well-made-play polish.

items.name: François Truffaut
items.notes: Intimate tracking; childhood as plot; cinephile warmth; refuses cold thesis-only scenes.

items.name: Ida Lupino
items.notes: Social-problem night; economy of setups; women under pressure; refuses studio glamour as the point.

items.name: Oscar Micheaux
items.notes: Race-film urgency; independent means; community address; refuses Hollywood as the only stage.

items.name: Ousmane Sembène
items.notes: Fable clarity; colonial leftover as set; chorus of town; refuses savior outsiders.

items.name: Chantal Akerman
items.notes: Domestic duration; frontal rooms; labor as cinema; refuses motivated 'movie' blocking.

items.name: Krzysztof Kieślowski
items.notes: Color as motif; chance ethics; quiet metaphysics; refuses sermon dialogue.
